macro.overnight_read: Crypto fear & greed is at 10 (extreme fear) and BTC RSI is 21, suggesting a possible bottom but still weak; most major forex pairs are in a downtrend against the strong USD, with JPY, CAD and CHF showing bearish spec positioning, so expect the USD to stay firm and risk assets to be subdued at the open.
macro.summary: The market is in a risk‑off mode with VIX above 25 and the dollar near multi‑month highs. Focus on safe‑haven bets like long gold and long JPY/CAD/CHF while staying short the USD and avoiding crypto and equity momentum. Keep core swing trades modest, use macro/forex and mean‑reversion ideas, and stay light on high‑risk speculative plays ahead of the upcoming data releases.
